description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between W. A. D. P. Perera Battaramulla and other part National Water Supply and Drainage Board Rathmalana
categorisation: This gazette content primarily consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises statutory powers granted by that legislation. While it mentions a government minister (Manusha Nanayakkara), this is in the context of exercising legal authority rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature, dealing with the implementation of labor dispute resolution mechanisms under existing legislation.
